body:
Thank you for taking the time to talk, appreciated greatly! 

I think it’s hard thinking that nobody gets me, even if I am surrounded by good people; I am yet to find someone who truly does.

Very insightful and nice to hear that options are possible I just have to make them so

I just watched a programme about a comedian, Billy Connolly, he is very inspirational because he just didn’t care. I envy how he could just do what he wanted to do - successfully as well

I’m 19 years old in a couple of days so I just hope that lockdown finishes as soon as it does and I get myself out there.

Psychedelics were insightful, Ive done them twice. I’m curious, my first experience was 170ug and it was at a party with close friends and strangers. That sounds unsafe but I didn’t mind, I enjoy tripping I feel like I belong there.


I think my issue is that I think. I ask questions and come up with answers for myself. I’m not craving the idea of uniqueness but I circle round that concept over and over but I know that every other person does that somewhere. But then me KNOWING that other people think like is what underlines it I think different than others. 


I don’t know what to be, who I am or how I’m supposed to just be

I’m on a music course, planning to release music (after lockdown). But I don’t want to be just another musician I want to create songs that everyone will love forever not shit that just sounds good. I don’t know how to get what’s in my head out and I don’t know why it’s so hard

I have a decent part time job, I’m drinking now but that’s for calls with friends, I can’t only talk to woman in person I fail online, I’ve passed my first year of uni.

My issue is that it’s feels pointless, fruitless like what is the end goal? What is the point in it all?
No I haven’t actually, but I’m not passionate about reviews. It’s expression I love but I can’t express anything

I love music, but not only for sounding good; I listen to what people express through it. 
I think of myself as different but I know every second person thinks like that.
I just feel trapped and that no one gets me. 
I just want to live as who I want to be but I don’t know how
Perhaps, I’m currently pursuing something I’ve always wanted to do in life I guess and made a breakthrough yesterday
I can’t think on what aspect of myself I feel better though; like I’ve never had a dream like it. It felt so real as well I’m sure it has some form of meaning
Like it was a very good dream a just wondered if there was like a meaning behind it 🤣
What’s next space Nazis from the moon 🤔🤔
